subject: Workspace console + API walkthrough — confirm session window and prep
messages:
From: Ella Ramos <ella.ramos@brightloop.ai>
To: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir@brightloop.ai>
Date: Wed, 1 Jul 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: BrightLoop: Schedule console walkthrough + API enablement

Hi Laura,

Thanks again for the quick demo last week. Our engineering and product teams are ready to get a hands-on walkthrough so they can start integrating. We think a 90-minute session that covers the console (roles, routes, observability) followed by API enablement (keys, sample calls, auth and best practices) would be ideal.

Availability on our side (PDT):
- Tue Jul 6: 10:00–12:00 or 14:00–16:00
- Wed Jul 7: 09:00–11:00
- Thu Jul 8: 10:00–12:00

If you can propose 2 concrete time windows, we can lock one and send a calendar invite. Also please share any prep or sample requests we should complete beforehand.

I've attached a short scope doc that outlines our goals.

Thanks,
Ella Ramos
Head of Product
BrightLoop AI
attachments: BrightLoop_Scope.pdf (PDF, 240KB)
From: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Ella Ramos <ella.ramos@brightloop.ai>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir@brightloop.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 2 Jul 2026 09:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BrightLoop: Schedule console walkthrough + API enablement

Hi Ella — great to hear you're ready to get deeper. Thanks for the availability.
We can do a 90-minute combined session; our recommended slots (PDT) are:
- Wed Jul 7: 14:00–15:30
- Thu Jul 8: 10:00–11:30

Monica (training lead) and Dev (API engineer) are cc'd to confirm they can cover the agenda items. I've attached a draft agenda and a short API quickstart checklist that your engineers can run through before the session.
If those slots don't work, we can split into two focused 60-minute sessions (console first, api second) to be kinder to folks who need to step away. Which do you prefer?
Best,
Laura Bennett
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
Mobile: (415) 555-0142
attachments: Redwood_Onboarding_Agenda.pdf; API-Quickstart-Checklist.xlsx

Cc: Samir Patel <samir@brightloop.ai>
Date: Thu, 2 Jul 2026 11:01:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BrightLoop: Schedule console walkthrough + API enablement

Hi Laura — thanks, Thu Jul 8 10:00–11:30 PDT works best for our team (that's the slot we can free up). We prefer the combined session so we can get end-to-end context in one go.

One quick note: we have a small EU team joining remotely and they're likely to dip out for the tail end of the session. If you can call out the API auth and sample flow in the first 45–50 minutes, that would be helpful.

I'll send the calendar invite once you confirm and can share access to your slide deck/preread.

Cheers,
Ella

3) Any specific prep you'd like BrightLoop to do before the session (I suggested the quickstart checklist)
Also, can you add the trainer roster to the shared folder so I can include it in the invite?

Given the EU overlap, I'd recommend we keep the 90-min combined session but reorder the agenda so API auth + sample calls occur in the first 50 minutes, then console walkthrough and observability examples in the last 40. We'll call out "core steps" in the slide deck and leave optional demos for the tail.
I've uploaded the trainer roster to Drive and added a short note on who will lead each segment. attachment: Trainer_Roster.docx
Happy to split into two sessions if BrightLoop insists, but I think a reordered single session is cleaner for alignment.

Hi Ella — confirming Thu Jul 8, 10:00–11:30 PDT for the BrightLoop onboarding session.

Plan / quick notes:
- Zoom: https://us02web.zoom.us/j/81234567890?pwd=example
- We reordered the agenda so API auth & sample calls are covered in the first ~50 minutes, console and observability examples in the final ~40.
- Attachments: BrightLoop_Onboarding_Agenda.pdf, API-Quickstart-Checklist.xlsx, Trainer_Roster.docx (already shared to your Drive folder).
- Prep ask: Please ensure at least one engineer completes steps 1–3 on the quickstart checklist (API key generation, one sample call to the sandbox, and paste any errors into a Google doc) — this will let us jump into troubleshooting if needed.

If you'd like us to record the session and drop the recording in the shared Drive, we'll do that by default unless you tell us otherwise.

Looking forward to it — I'll accept your invite once it lands.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
